events.title: Lincoln delivers his 'House Divided' speech
events.description: Accepting the Illinois Republican Senate nomination in Springfield, Abraham Lincoln warned that the United States could not endure permanently half slave and half free. The speech drew a sharp line over slavery's future.
events.significance: The speech made Lincoln a national voice against the spread of slavery. It helped set him on the road to the presidency two years later.

events.title: Ford Motor Company is incorporated
events.description: Henry Ford and a small group of investors formally founded the Ford Motor Company. It began as a modest venture, and within a few years it was building cars for ordinary families.
events.significance: Ford went on to introduce the Model T and the moving assembly line. Those innovations transformed manufacturing and put the automobile within reach of the masses.

events.title: The first Bloomsday: the day of Joyce's Ulysses
events.description: James Joyce set his novel Ulysses on this single Dublin day, following Leopold Bloom as he wanders the city. The date is now celebrated every year as Bloomsday.
events.significance: Ulysses is regarded as one of the defining works of modern literature. Each June 16, readers around the world mark it with readings and festivals.

events.title: Valentina Tereshkova becomes the first woman in space
events.description: Soviet cosmonaut Valentina Tereshkova launched aboard Vostok 6 and orbited the Earth. She was the first woman to fly in space.
events.significance: Her flight was a landmark for women in science and exploration. It was also a high point of the Space Race.
